item.title: PHP Methods for Formatting JSON Output Readability
item.description:
“PHP Methods for Formatting JSON Output Readability”

How can a developer reliably format raw JSON data into an easily readable, indented structure using PHP, especially considering varying PHP versions and output environments (CLI vs. browser)? We examine multiple effective solutions for improving JSON string readability.

Built-in PHP Functionality for JSON Pretty Printing

The most direct approach leverages PHP’s native capabilities, available since PHP 5.4.

Utilizing JSON_PRETTY_PRINT

The simplest path involves using the JSON_PRETTY_PRINT flag within json_encode(). This directly instructs the encoder to format the output with newlines and indentation.
